name: M5.SupportPolynomial.quotient_monomial_period
statement: ∀ T a j : ℕ, AdjoinRoot.mk (M5.cyclicModulus T) ((Polynomial.X : M5.BinaryPolynomial) ^ (a + j * T)) = AdjoinRoot.mk (M5.cyclicModulus T) ((Polynomial.X : M5.BinaryPolynomial) ^ a)
guidance: The quotient map kills cyclicModulus T=X^T+1 by AdjoinRoot.mk_self. Mapping the sum and characteristic two yield root^T=1. Use map_pow, AdjoinRoot.mk_X, pow_add and pow_mul to reduce exponent a+j*T. This holds also T=0; no irreducibility or nontrivial quotient assumption is permitted. Return only tactic lines without a leading by. Preserve the exact target.
